description_en: Associates one or more load balancing instances with a scaling group to distribute access traffic to multiple instances in the scaling group and enhance the service capability of the scaling group. You can call the AttachLoadBalancers API operation to add one or more load balancing instances
description_zh: 伸缩组支持关联负载均衡实例，通过负载均衡实例将访问流量分发到伸缩组内的多个实例中，可以有效增强伸缩组的服务能力，您可以调用API AttachLoadBalancers添加一个或多个负载均衡实例
name: AttachLoadBalancers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add all existing instances in the scaling group as backend servers of the load balancing instances. Valid values:
         
true: adds all existing instances. If this parameter is set to `true`, when the load balancing instances are added to the scaling group, the system adds all existing instances in the scaling group as backend servers of the load balancing instances.

If a load balancing instance is already added to the scaling group and you want to add all instances in the scaling group as backend servers of the load balancing instance, you can add the load balancing instance to the scaling group again and set ForceAttach to true.

false: does not add existing instances. If this parameter is set to false, when the load balancing instances are added to the scaling group, the system does not add the existing instances in the scaling group as backend servers of the load balancing instances.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否把当前伸缩组内的实例全部添加为负载均衡实例的后端服务器，取值范围：
         
true：添加。如果该参数值为`true`，则将负载均衡实例添加到伸缩组时，系统会将当前伸缩组中已有的实例全部添加为负载均衡实例的后端服务器。

如果负载均衡实例已添加至伸缩组，而您需要将伸缩组中全部实例添加为该负载均衡实例的后端服务器，则您可以再次将该负载均衡实例添加到伸缩组，并选择ForceAttach为true状态。

false：不添加。如果该参数值为false，则将负载均衡实例添加到伸缩组时，系统不会将当前伸缩组中已有的实例添加为负载均衡实例的后端服务器。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_attach

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use asynchronous calls when adding load balancing instances. Asynchronous calls ensure the transactionality of operations, meaning that either all operations succeed or none of the operations take effect if any operation fails. Use asynchronous calls. Valid values:
true: asynchronous call. The request returns the ID of the scaling activity.
false: synchronous call.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
添加负载均衡实例时，是否采用异步调用的方式。异步调用能保证操作的事务性，即所有操作都执行成功或者某个操作失败时所有操作的执行结果都不生效，建议您采用异步调用。
取值范围：
true：异步调用。请求将返回伸缩活动的ID。
false：同步调用。

默认值：false
parameters.name: async

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the load balancing CLB (formerly SLB) instances to add
parameters.help_zh: 需要添加的负载均衡CLB（原SLB）实例的ID列表
parameters.name: load_balancers

fields.help_en: The ID of the load balancing CLB (formerly SLB) instance
fields.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en:
The weight of the ECS instance or ECI instance as a backend server after Auto Scaling adds the instance to the SLB server group. A higher weight indicates that the ECS instance or ECI instance is allocated more access requests. If the weight is 0, the ECS instance or ECI instance does not receive access requests.

Valid values: 0 to 100
fields.help_zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到SLB服务器组后，ECS实例或ECI实例作为后端服务器的权重。权重越高，ECS实例或ECI实例将被分配到越多的访问请求。如果权重为0，则ECS实例或ECI实例不会收到访问请求。

取值范围：0~100
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The configurations of the load balancing CLB (formerly SLB) instances
parameters.name: load_balancer_configs

ScalingActivityId.description_en:
The ID of the scaling activity.

This value is returned only when Async is set to `true`. You can call the DescribeScalingActivities operation to query the returned scaling activity ID and view the execution status of the scaling activity
ScalingActivityId.description_zh:
伸缩活动的ID。

仅当`Async`为`true`时返回该值。您可使用API DescribeScalingActivities遍历查询返回的伸缩活动ID，查看伸缩活动的执行状态
